item.title: Tunisian Film “Lily” Wins Inaugural $1M Google AI Film Award at 1 Billion Followers Summit

item.title: Kenyan University Students Win U.S.-Kenya AI Challenge With Maternal Health Platform
item.description: A team of Kenyan university students has won the Stars of Innovation: U.S.-Kenya AI Challenge after developing an artificial intelligence-powered platform aimed at addressing maternal health challenges in the country.
